people.name: Nesha Pai
sources: Accounting scope, published fees and preparation boundary
Nesha Pai public podcast and hiatus notice
people.profile: Nesha Pai is identified as Pai CPA’s founder and managing member. Her public platform also includes speaking and a podcast, whose reviewed page marks the show on hiatus.
people.offering: Pai CPA describes monthly accounting, financial reporting, accounting setup and coaching. Its service page expressly separates income tax filings through a Tax CPA from its own one-state sales tax preparation.
people.scenario: Your books need cleanup before a tax plan. Compare monthly close, cleanup and tax-preparer coordination, then separately assign income tax filing and individualized planning.
questions: Who prepares income tax returns under a separate contract?
What monthly accounting and sales tax tasks are included?
What cleanup costs and meeting access apply?
Who implements and checks any planning recommendations?
people.boundary: The reviewed service page says Pai CPA does not do income tax filings and coordinates with a Tax CPA. Do not infer that accounting support includes an income tax return or that podcast access is client service.
people.fee: The reviewed service page lists accounting starting at $700/month, setup at $1,000 and coaching at $350/hour; cleanup is extra. These are distinct accounting offers, not a universal planning-and-filing package. Confirm current terms.

people.name: Jackie Meyer
sources: Official author, speaking and firm-owner education
TaxPlanIQ founder story and 2022 firm sale

people.offering: Compare professional tax-planning software, firm-owner education and speaking with a separate taxpayer engagement. A software subscription is a tool used by an advisor, rather than the advisor’s contract to prepare your return.
people.scenario: You follow Jackie’s planning content but need help with your own company. Establish whether you are buying software for a practice, professional training or a named firm’s taxpayer service.
questions: Is the buyer a tax practice or an individual taxpayer?
Which software, training and support are included?
Which professional reviews and signs off on my personal facts?
Is client advice or return preparation separately contracted?
people.boundary: Current founder education and software should not be presented as proof Jackie personally accepts private tax clients. Verify the current contracting entity; older Meyer Tax materials predate the stated sale.
people.fee: Request the current product-specific software or education price and renewal terms. The reviewed biography and founder pages do not establish a fixed private taxpayer engagement fee.

How are CFO, advisory and filing fees scoped?

people.name: Hannah Cole
sources: Sunlight Tax education, consultations and business setup
Hannah Cole tax education and podcast resources
people.profile: Hannah Cole’s Sunlight Tax site identifies her as a tax professional, artist, educator and podcast host serving self-employed people.
people.offering: The public site offers books, workshops, education, limited one-to-one consultations and a two-day solo business setup intensive. The intensive describes tax tracking, estimated payment calculations and bookkeeping setup.
people.scenario: You are a self-employed artist choosing between learning to maintain your own systems and hiring a team. Compare education, consultation and setup deliverables separately from recurring income tax filing.
questions: Does this include education, consultation or hands-on setup?
Who reviews my figures and estimated payment calculation?
Which follow-up and ongoing bookkeeping tasks are included?
Are income tax returns and legal work separately contracted?
people.boundary: The reviewed site includes individual consultations and setup assistance; do not describe it as education only. Confirm availability, professional responsibilities and whether ongoing filing is actually part of the chosen agreement.
people.fee: Request the current price for the specific book, workshop, consultation or intensive. The reviewed public overview does not establish one fixed fee for ongoing planning, bookkeeping and return preparation.

Who reviews my records and implements the recommendation?
Do I need a separate tax advisor, preparer or attorney?

people.fee: The reviewed official publication does not establish a current fee for private legal advice, tax planning or filing. Price any book or education purchase separately from a professional engagement.
